title: Two Forecasts, One Sky: AIGFS and GFS forecasts against station measurements
license: CC0-1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/); underlying NOAA/NWS data is public domain
source: NOAA / National Weather Service: AIGFS (NOMADS), GFS (NOAA open data on AWS), station readings (NWS API), station rain (NOAA Aviation Weather Center). Not affiliated with or endorsed by NOAA.
notes: Temperatures in deg C at 2 m, at each station's nearest grid point. Rain: 6-hour totals in mm ending at the evening (00:00 UTC); measured rain from the 6-hour group of each station's 00:00 UTC report (trace = less than 0.01 in). Empty values are missing, never zero. Methods: https://github.com/davidpetry-cloud/two-forecasts-one-sky/blob/main/docs/protocol.md
